digest.component_or_area: external integration test suite for multi-project Jira synchronization
propositions: Non-existent project keys configured in the mapping cause real Jira to return parse errors and abort the entire inbound pass because the fetcher lacks per-project exception handling
A fake stateful transport masked cross-project isolation failures by returning empty for unknown projects instead of erroring, making live Cloud validation necessary
Only two production Cloud projects cannot model all required repo configurations and failure scenarios without contaminating each other
A rehearsal against ephemeral Jira DC scratch projects with dry-run preview gating can reproducibly validate cross-project isolation and prevent inter-project mutation contamination
The library wraps applier exceptions in RebarError and requires callers to expect the wrapped error type, not the original exception class
Session-scoped teardown must reliably delete all scratch projects on every exit path to prevent leaked data between runs
